title: Real Estate Agency in Louisville, KY | Compass and Key Group
description: Compass and Key Group helps buyers and sellers in Louisville, KY, from south Louisville and the I-65 corridor to moves to and from Hardin County.
h1: Real Estate Agency in Louisville, KY
intro: Compass and Key Group is a local real estate team serving Louisville buyers and sellers, especially in south Louisville and along the I-65 corridor. Based in Elizabethtown, about 45 minutes south, we know both Jefferson County and Hardin County, so if you're moving between Louisville and E-town in either direction, one team can handle both sides of the move.
